name: Hugo
intro: Hey, newbie! Here, we settle everything with a debate. Show me what you've got!
defeat: Argh… I should have reread my briefing notes.
win: Ha! Back to the photocopier!

name: Oliver
intro: So, {P}, shall we test our Euromons? Mine is obviously better.
defeat: What?! That was a lucky shot!
win: Easy. As expected.

name: Oliver
intro: {P}! You already have a badge? Never mind, I'll make you regret it.
defeat: Not again… Fine, you'll see in Frankfurt.
win: Ha! Luxembourg suits me.

name: Oliver
intro: I've just visited the ECB. I understood everything about monetary policy. Almost everything.
defeat: Bloody hell… You're really improving fast, {P}.
win: As they say in the City: time is money.

name: Oliver
intro: {P}… this is our last debate. After this, I'm going back to London. For good. Come on, one last time!
defeat: Good game, {P}. At least I'm leaving in style.
win: I'm leaving on a win. That's something.

name: Oliver
intro: {P}! I'm back. Well… I'm asking to come back. Rejoin? But first, a debate for honour!
defeat: Right. I'm filling in the membership application. It's 35 chapters long…
win: Ha! Turns out leaving makes you stronger. Or not.

defeat: Right. I'm filling in the membership application. It's 35 chapters long…
win: Ha! Turns out leaving makes you stronger. Or not.

name: Léa
intro: I'm an intern too! Unpaid, like you. Let's debate, it's comforting.
defeat: Well… back to the photocopies.

name: Mr Dupont
intro: Halt! Has your A-38 hiking form been stamped?
defeat: Fine, I'll stamp it. But in triplicate.

name: Gérard
intro: The CAP is my life! And my tractor is my family. Come on, let's debate!
defeat: I'll have to raise this with the union…

name: Pierre-Henri
intro: Welcome to Luxembourg. Absolute discretion. This debate never happened.
defeat: This debate definitely never happened.

name: Counsel Klein
intro: A tax ruling? I'll draft you one in five minutes. But first, a debate.
defeat: My arrangements… collapsed!

name: Jean-Claude Juncker
intro: Ah, a young intern! Come, come, let me pat your cheek. Then we'll debate, like in the good old Eurogroup days.
defeat: Bravo! You deserve the Tax Ruling Badge. And that's not confidential!
win: Come on, don't make that face, I'm joking… half joking.

name: Kevin
intro: I'm cycling the Moselle! And debating in roaming, for free!
defeat: Even without roaming charges, I've lost everything.

name: Hans
intro: The markets are pricing in my victory at 87%.
defeat: The markets were wrong. As usual.

name: Jean-Marc
intro: My crémant is PDO. So are my Euromons. Almost.
defeat: Well, I'll buy you a drink anyway.

name: Karl
intro: Buy low, sell high, debate hard!
defeat: Crash! I'm overdrawn!

name: Dr Sofia
intro: According to my model, you lose. My model is never wrong. Except in 2008.
defeat: I'll have to revise my forecasts.

name: Christine Lagarde
intro: Welcome to the European Central Bank. Here, I set the rates… and the pace of the debate. My attacks depend on today's key rate!
defeat: Wonderful. You deserve the Euro Badge. And don't worry: I'm not here to close your spread.
win: Price stability is also the stability of victories.

name: Inès
intro: Every debate lost is one more degree! Come on!
defeat: Well, at least it was carbon-neutral.

name: Tom
intro: An exclusive! “Intern loses miserably”!
defeat: I'm changing the headline: “Intern wins miserably well”.

name: Albert
intro: Is the Rhine the border? No, it's wine on both sides! We'll drink a toast after the debate.
defeat: Cheers anyway!

name: MEP Muller
intro: I tabled 2,000 amendments this morning. The first one is about you.
defeat: My amendments were rejected en bloc…

name: MEP Rossi
intro: The session is in Strasbourg, our trunks have arrived, let's debate!
defeat: I'm going back to Brussels. With my trunks.

name: Roberta Metsola
intro: Silence in the hemicycle! The sitting is open. I give the floor to… you. Then I take it back.
defeat: Adopted! The Hemicycle Badge is awarded to you by an absolute majority.
win: The sitting is closed. Come back for the next session.

name: Nikos
intro: Debt is like moussaka: hard to digest.
defeat: OXI to this defeat!

name: Troika agent (ECB)
intro: Account inspection! Your Euromons spend too much.
defeat: Inspection report: unfavourable.

name: Troika agent (IMF)
intro: The International Monetary Fund recommends… your defeat.
defeat: Revision of our forecasts: downwards.

name: Yanis Varoufakis
intro: I came by motorbike, no tie. Like in 2015 against the Eurogroup. We debate, and then we vote: OXI or NAI?
defeat: OXI… sorry, NAI: you win. Take the OXI Badge, comrade.
win: The people have spoken. And the people is me.

name: Editor-in-chief
intro: FRONT PAGE: “Brussels wants to ban bent bananas”! It's false? Who cares, it sells.
defeat: Tomorrow's front page: “Historic defeat”.

name: Boris Johnson
intro: Hello! I was a Brussels correspondent, you know. I wrote things… more or less true. Get debate done!
defeat: Crikey. Well, I had another article about straight cucumbers anyway.

name: Nigel Farage
intro: You're not laughing now, are you? Welcome to the pub. A debate, a pint, and Article 50.
defeat: Right. Take the Article 50 Badge. We don't need it any more.
win: Take back control! Of the debate, at least.

name: Gábor
intro: Check! Does your Euromon have a visa?
defeat: Go through. But I'm writing it down.

name: Special adviser
intro: The Prime Minister receives no one. Except those who beat me. And that never happens.
defeat: It just happened.

name: Viktor Orbán
intro: You want my agreement? Unanimity is required. And I never agree. Careful: I can use my VETO every turn.
defeat: Fine… I'm stepping out for a coffee. Meanwhile, take this Veto Badge. Officially, I abstained.
win: Veto! Veto! And veto again!

name: Oil lobbyist
intro: You don't have your access badge? Good, neither do we.
defeat: I'll have to declare this meeting in the transparency register…

name: Tech lobbyist
intro: Our algorithm predicted your defeat. Accept cookies?
defeat: Error 403: defeat.

name: Lobbyiste « de l'étranger »
intro: A little suitcase for your vote? No? Then a debate.
defeat: I never gave anything to anyone. Write that down.

name: The Chief Lobbyist
intro: Welcome to the heart of power, intern. Here, we don't write laws: we “suggest” them. And you're going to sign my suggestion.
defeat: Impossible… A mere unpaid intern… has defeated the lobby. I'm retiring. To the private sector. Oh, I'm already there.
win: Thank you for this contribution to our public consultation.

name: Big Tech lawyer
intro: My client contests the €4.34 billion fine. And this debate.
defeat: We will appeal.

name: Competition lawyer
intro: Abuse of a dominant position? Me? I'm merely dominant.
defeat: Fine accepted…

name: Margrethe Vestager
intro: Google, Apple… I've imposed billions in fines. Does your team respect competition rules? Let's check.
defeat: No abuse of a dominant position detected. The Fine Badge is yours.
win: Fined! 4% of your turnover.

name: Ghost assistant
intro: Boo… I've worked here… since 2009… well, on paper…
defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

name: Ghost assistant
intro: Boo… I've worked here… since 2009… well, on paper…
defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

intro: Boo… I've worked here… since 2009… well, on paper…
defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

name: Ghost assistant
intro: Boo… I've worked here… since 2009… well, on paper…
defeat: I'm going back… to my fictitious… contract…

name: The Empty Contract
intro: I AM… THE SUM OF EVERY CONTRACT THAT NEVER HAD AN OFFICE…
defeat: My… payslips… are fading…

name: ENA graduate
intro: I went to the ENA. Well, the INSP. Anyway, I know everything.
defeat: I'll write a memo about this failure.

name: Junior minister
intro: I've been a minister since… this morning. Let's debate before the next reshuffle.
defeat: Reshuffled!

name: Emmanuel Macron
intro: Welcome to the Sorbonne! Here, I spoke about a sovereign Europe in 2017… and in 2024. I'll talk to you for two hours. And at the same time, debate.
defeat: Wonderful! You embody strategic autonomy. Take the Sorbonne Badge… and at the same time, my congratulations.
win: I dissolve… your team!

name: Angela Merkel
intro: Wir schaffen das. Together, we'll get there. But first, you have to beat me. Take your time: I have sixteen years of experience.
defeat: You did it. Wir haben es geschafft.

name: Mario Draghi
intro: I'll do whatever it takes to win this debate. Whatever it takes. And believe me: it will be enough.
defeat: My report recommended 800 billion of investment a year. Invest it in your team.

name: Kaja Kallas
intro: High Representative for Foreign Affairs. My diplomacy is firm. So is my Baltic shield.
defeat: A clear victory. Europe will need people like you facing the rest of the world.

name: António Costa
intro: It's 11:59 p.m. My goal: finish this summit before midnight. For the first time in history!
defeat: It's… 4:37 in the morning. As usual. Well done, you may go up to the Berlaymont.

name: Ursula von der Leyen
intro: Welcome to the thirteenth floor of the Berlaymont. I live here, you know: I have a bedroom next to my office. So, let's see whether you deserve the directive.
defeat: Team Europe… You're the best intern the Commission has ever had. The clock directive is yours!
win: I'll send you a text. Or maybe not.

name: JD Vance
intro: I came to Munich to explain democracy to you. Now I've come to Antwerp to explain debating.
defeat: Right. I'm going back to writing a speech.

name: Donald Trump
intro: TREMENDOUS! The most beautiful debate of all time, everybody says so. I'm putting 200% tariffs on your Euromons. Maybe 15. We'll see.
defeat: IT WAS RIGGED! Fine… let's make a deal. 15%. That's my final word. For today.
win: I won! As always! Nobody wins better than me.

name: Vladimir Putin
intro: Sit down. No, further away. Even further. There. At six metres, the conversation is more… strategic. Your attacks will take a turn to arrive.
defeat: The gas… has been cut off… on my side. Interesting.
win: Winter is coming. For you.

name: Xi Jinping
intro: Welcome. We are partners. And competitors. And systemic rivals. It depends on the turn.
defeat: Hmm. A partner to be respected. I'm lifting the controls on rare earths… for now.
win: Content unavailable in your region.

name: Donald Trump
intro: ME FIRST. The summit was my idea. Well, I think so.
defeat: Sad!

name: Vladimir Putin
intro: I preferred the long table.

name: Xi Jinping
intro: The last word will be… systemic.
defeat: We will talk again in fifty years.
